verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk-action capability, such as applying one operation across many clips or images at once. 'Unlimited parallel generations' is a plan concurrency limit, an adjacent feature rather than bulk operations. The OpenAPI and MCP surfaces are developer building blocks a user could script against, not a bulk feature of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
